turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want a better bedtime routine. Right now I just scroll until I pass out.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A wind down routine can really help. What would you enjoy doing in the last half hour instead, reading, stretching, or maybe a warm shower?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need a minute with my roommate. Just stay silent until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ben, come look at this. Is that water stain on the ceiling getting bigger?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm, yeah, it looks darker than yesterday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great. Do you think it's the roof or the upstairs bathroom?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's right under the tub, so my bet's the bathroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll check the seal around the tub tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Put a towel down in the meantime, just in case.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We were building your bedtime routine.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A shower and some stretching, I think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice combo. The drop in body temperature after a warm shower actually helps you fall asleep.
